text: The Reyrolle 7SR119 is a retrofit solution, replacing older Argus 7SG1114 devices with a modern 7SR11. This four-pole non-directional overcurrent protection device provides essential protection, monitoring, instrumentation and metering for your switchgear.
heading: Why Reyrolle 7SR119?

text: Replacing legacy protection devices often involves significant disruption, complex re-wiring and new case installations. The 7SR119 minimizes these challenges with quick, easy installation. It eliminates new panel cutouts or changes to existing wiring, saving hours of engineering and commissioning time.
heading: Why Reyrolle 7SR119?

text: Enjoy protection features like undercurrent and arc flash detection, improving operational safety and reliability.
